review_evidence: README identifies this as a Lean 4 RDF library for parsing and serialization.
Direct inspection of RDF/Triple.lean found the Subject, Predicate, Object, Triple, and RDFList formal data model, coercions, notation, and list construction operations.
Direct inspection of lakefile.lean found only the RDF package/library target and an extern_lib recipe invoking cargo and copying the resulting shared library.

rules.content_invariant: The exact lakefile owns only Lake and Rust FFI build plumbing. RDF types, vocabulary, triples, parsing and serialization interfaces remain retained in RDF/** and RDF.lean.
evidence: lakefile.lean declares package RDF, lean_lib RDF, and an extern_lib build rule that runs cargo and copies the shared library; no RDF data-model definition or theorem appears there.
rules.rationale: Exclude the exact build/FFI configuration from primary formalization search while retaining all RDF formal source.

summary: Retain the RDF data model and parsing/serialization interface; exclude only the exact Lake/Rust build configuration.
